name: Dakota Precision Fabricating, Inc.
old_description: Dakota Precision Fabricating, Inc. has completed many successful projects with Flood Control America, LLC a leading supplier of removable flood control products.
about:
Dakota Precision Fabricating, Inc. operates from Forman, North Dakota.

The company specializes in miscellaneous metal fabrications, producing stairways, ladders, catwalks, grating systems, and guard railing. In addition to these standard products, the shop undertakes light to heavy structural steel projects for apartment complexes and new construction builds, handling both smaller framing jobs and larger structural assemblies.

The firm's customer base includes Flood Control America, LLC, a supplier of removable flood control products, indicating a presence in the flood protection market. Its structural work supports the construction industry, particularly multi-family residential and commercial new construction projects.
